task: Welcome to another life changing game of TextWorld! Here is your task for today. First step, make an effort to take a trip north. With that over with, move west. Next, ensure that the portal is open. And then, make an attempt to go north. And then, make an effort to travel east. With that accomplished, lift the chocolate bar from the floor of the canteen. Alright, thanks!
description:
You arrive in a studio.

Were you looking for a chair? Because look over there, it's a chair. I guess it's true what they say, if you're looking for a chair, go to TextWorld. Unfortunately, there isn't a thing on it.

There is an open gate leading north. There is an open gateway leading west.

thought: I should go north first as the task instructs to take a trip north.
feedback:
You've entered a dish-pit. The room seems oddly familiar, as though it were only superficially different from the other rooms in the building.

You make out a saucepan. The saucepan is standard. Looks like someone's already been here and taken everything off it, though.

There is an open gate leading south. There is an open passageway leading west.
